body.x: Sonist will participate in the world’slargest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 toshowcase its breathing rehabilitation game Funny Jelly.

Sonist, the R&D startup of software-type medical devices, is developing a solution that enables easy and convenient breathing rehabilitation exercises anytime and anywhere using a smartphone. Sonist's software-type medical device has demonstrated its effectiveness of respiratory rehabilitation exercises from the clinical trial run by the National Rehabilitation Center, and has been approved for Grade 2 medical stimulus-generating machinery.

The breathing rehabilitation game FunnyJelly runs by breathing into the microphone built into the smart device, theusers can practice breathing naturally by playing the game. This solutiontargets spinal cord injury, a group of SCI patients.

An official said, “It's a game-typesoftware-type medical device that helps breathing rehabilitation exercise morefun and steady at home. We will keep the “breath” precious for all of us withSonist’s solution that can be used by all patients of respiratory diseases andanyone."

He continued, “We will continue to work on technical research to develop a variety of respiratory training solutions for each user group. We want to create a world free of medical blind spots by providing remote respiratory rehabilitation solutions across the world beyond the Korean, North American and Middle East markets."

The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January.
